classicMode.title: Classic Zoom Mode
classicMode.text: In this mode, 100% zoom means the entire image fits within the visible area without cropping.

textMode.title: Text Zoom Mode
textMode.text: In this mode, 100% zoom means the image width matches the full width of the text area relative to the page, where the page represents the entire viewport.

textWidth.tip: Set text width or double click to icon for reset
